name: The Harbour Bell
effect: The bell rings once and the tide begins to turn.
options: Take the helm|gx-crossing#extra=reputation:1#says=You take the wheel yourself and the crew fall in behind you.;Wait for dawn|gx-wait#says=You let the tide settle and the crew sleep on the decision.
context: The harbour bell rings once, the tide turns in the dark, and the crew look to the wheel. The pilot is ashore and the channel is narrowing.

name: The Reef Line
effect: The reef shows itself in the swell a heartbeat before the hull does.
options: Chart the reef|gx-reef#cost=coins:2#says=You buy the pilot's chart and the soundings are honest.;Cut the line|gx-wait#says=You cut the tow line and let the current carry the barge clear.
context: The reef line runs across the channel mouth and the swell shows it a heartbeat before the hull does. The pilot's chart is for sale, and the barge is still on the tow.

name: Broken Water
effect: The reef takes a bite out of the night.
options: Signal the shore|gx-signal#cost=coins:1#extra=reputation:1#says=You spend the last of the harbour money on a shore signal and the watch answers.;Turn back|gx-wait#says=You turn back into the channel and lose the night's run.
context: Broken water all around, and the shore watch is awake. A signal costs money you have, and the crew are watching to see whether the harbour answers.

name: The Shore Answers
effect: The watch answers and the water opens.
options: Anchor for the night|gx-end-quiet#says=You anchor inside the harbour wall and the crew sleep.;Run the strait|gx-end-quiet#when=reputation>=2>gx-end-bold#says=You run the strait on the watch's word and the town will remember it.
context: The watch answers and the channel opens ahead of you. The crew will follow a captain the town trusts, and they are asking which way to run.

name: Waiting Tide
effect: The tide waits and so does the crew.
options: Make harbour|gx-end-quiet#says=You make harbour with the tide and the night is done.;Signal the boat|gx-end-quiet#says=You signal the boat and it comes alongside.
context: The tide waits, and so does the crew. Either way the night ends in harbour, and the telling of it is all that differs.

name: Quiet Harbour
effect: The night ends in a quiet harbour.
context: The night ends in a quiet harbour and the town wakes to a full quay.

name: The Bold Run
effect: The town remembers the night the strait was run.
options: Sail again|gx-open#says=You sail again on the morning tide.
context: The town remembers the night the strait was run, and the crew ask when you will sail again.
